5196.title: HTML preview camera integration is not present on main
5196.rootCauseOneLine: The reported fork camera/bridge is absent from trusted main; its historical content endpoint was removed, and there is no second camera handler to shadow.
5196.proposedFix: No safe upstream bug fix: first establish the preview-camera feature and test its real serving route.
5196.caveats: High confidence in upstream scope mismatch only. Fork query handling, physical trackpad, Safari, and browser gestures were not tested. Two clean runs each passed 13 focused route checks.
